Definition: of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with G2281) the Red Sea:--red.
BiblicalUsage: The word erythrós covers red, that is the Red Sea. It occurs just once, in Hebrews.
TheologicalSignificance: I take erythrós as it stands — red, that is the Red Sea — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
